posts.title: New 3D Virtual Replay feature added to the site
posts.body:
The COBRA Virtual Race Replay is now available in 3D. Watch recorded races on measured track layouts, follow a selected driver's car in the flyover view, and see live race timings while the replay runs.

Where matching race videos are available, you can also open the original footage on YouTube.

[View the new 3D Virtual Replay](https://racehub.cobracardiff.co.uk/virtual-race-replay/3d.html).

posts.title: New website and features
posts.body:
As you can now see, the new COBRA website is up and running, with some hopefully interesting stats and features for you. 

Anyone who has not yet, please upload an image of your car to the [Driver Car Avatars Upload Page](https://racehub.cobracardiff.co.uk/avatar-upload/).

These are used in an increasing number of areas of the site, from driver profiles to virtual race replays and the podium gallery.
